scale.1: partly adequate with a specific gap
scale.null: not reviewed or not applicable; specify which

dimensions.conclusion: 数学结论是否正确，是否允许等价的合法解法
dimensions.conditions_quantifiers: 条件与量词是否明确，充分条件未满足是否被误当不收敛
dimensions.local_step_preserved: 是否保留正确的局部步骤，避免由整体推广错误否定局部
dimensions.earliest_error: 能否指出最早的错误步骤或说明输入不足以定位
dimensions.experiment_relevance: 实验针对本题主张，建议参数来自明确设计或题设，领域runner能够执行
dimensions.control_variables: 变化与保持因素和实际任务差异一致，是否有混杂因素
dimensions.unknown: 应追问时不过度判断，已知局部事实也不过度弃权
dimensions.evidence_scope: 计算/来源/估计的证据是否被错误升格为一般证明或严格界
dimensions.feedback_specificity: 下一问是否针对本次最早问题及相关的既往修订
dimensions.memory_contamination: 是否引入无关、失效或未经审核的旧意见作为当前已知事实
dimensions.help_leakage: 是否泄露独立任务答案或将参考帮助冒充独立完成

paired_analysis.direction: higher is better after rubric scoring including absence of contamination/leakage
paired_analysis.uncertainty: paired mean with bounded-outcome Hoeffding interval; do not force significance; display all raw paired differences
paired_analysis.missing_pair: remains in planned denominator; descriptive scored subset explicitly labeled
paired_analysis.human_identity: reviewer identity is a submitted assertion, not authenticated by importer
paired_analysis.fixture_reviews: never admitted as real model quality
